fieldDescription: When set to true, at Market Size 9 and 10, this will increase industry size by 1.
When set to true, a message about the tech-mining ruins will appear indicating how much potential it has left. Only appears on unowned planets or player-owned planets.
When set to true, vanilla and whitelisted factions will auto-improve industries with SP over time.

Makes ALL alive markets be eligible for SP Improvements regardless of whitelisted factions in data/config/BetterColonyConfig/bc_autospfactions.csv. There is no setting to make all industries eligible. The industries must be added data/config/BetterColoniesConfig/bc_autospindustries.csv.
When set to true and have the mod Nexerelin active, invasions will unimprove industries that were disrupted at the end of an invasion.
Percentage of every month to spawn an Age of Innovation that will attempt to improve industries (default is 20%%).

fieldName: Age of Innovation Chance on Centralized Factions
fieldDescription: Percentage of every Age of Innovation event for centralized factions to decide to improve industries (default is 5%%).

fieldName: Age of Innovation Chance on Decentralized Factions
fieldDescription: Percentage of every Age of Innovation event for decentralized factions (Independents, Pirates, Pathers by vanilla examples) to decide to improve industries (default is 2%%).

fieldName: Age of Innovation SP Exponential Multiplier Chance
fieldDescription: Similar to how multiple improvements for the same colony cost more for the player, multiple improvements for the same colony has a lower chance to proc. This is the exponential multiplier for auto-improvement chance based on 1/x^(# of sp industry). For example, a market with 0 SP industry gets a 1/2^0 chance of improving (default: 2, lower than 2 will increase chance, higher than 2 will decrease chance).
